temporal_exclusions.v394: Visited health facility last 12 months -- ANC contacts ARE facility visits. Empirically: for births within the last 12 months, P(v394=1 | ANC>=1)=0.67 vs 0.28 for ANC=0, and the gap narrows to 0.56 vs 0.31 once the birth is 24-60 months back, i.e. once the ANC visits fall outside the 12-month recall window. That is the outcome being re-reported as a predictor.
temporal_exclusions.v395: Told about family planning at facility -- conditional on the same visit as v394.
temporal_exclusions.v393: Visited by fieldworker last 12 months -- same recall-window contamination.
temporal_exclusions.v781: Ever tested for HIV -- provider-initiated HIV testing is a routine component of Ethiopian ANC, so for this cohort the variable is partly a record of having attended ANC.
temporal_exclusions.v312: Current contraceptive method, measured at interview; postpartum FP is delivered at ANC/PNC contacts.
temporal_exclusions.v364: Contraceptive use and intention, as v312.
temporal_exclusions.v326: Source of current contraceptive method -- conditional on post-pregnancy service contact.
temporal_exclusions.v247b: Menstrual hygiene -- measured post-pregnancy, 36% missing, subsample only.
temporal_exclusions.v719: Works for family/other/self -- asked only of working women, 65% missing in cohort.
temporal_exclusions.m13_1: Timing of first ANC -- ANC-process variable, admissible only in the ANC-entry arm.
